top.title: 'You're not welcome here' - Chelsea's Fofana booed by own fans
top.description: Wesley Fofana has made 10 appearances for Chelsea this season. [Getty Images] Chelsea defender Wesley Fofana was subjected to repeated boos and told "you're not welcome here" by his own fans during Friday's Premier League defeat by Nottingham Forest. The jeers aimed at the 25-year-old were heard every time he touched the ball and came after an unauthorised interview with French YouTuber Zach Nani was released. In that controversial two-hour conversation, Fofana also appeared to joke about missing his penalty during last month's Carabao Cup shootout defeat by Liverpool. Manager Xabi Alonso said the French centre-back had apologised and "it won't be repeated". But Fofana endured a difficult time in his side's trip to Forest as supporters made their feelings known. After Chelsea went behind to a brilliant volley from Igor Jesus in the fifth minute, Fofana also conceded a penalty for the home side's second goal from Morgan Gibbs-White in the 51st minute. He was booked for the foul on Liam Delap in the box, and then replaced by Levi Colwill in the 56th minute - just after Emmanuel Emegha had pulled a goal back for the visitors - before Gibbs-White made it 3-1 in the 72nd minute. Emegha scored again in the 89th minute to make it 3-2, but Forest held on to secure their first win over Chelsea at the City Ground since 1997. Meanwhile, Nani has moved to defend Fofana, saying the player was "clearly" not happy during the interview and admitted he had to perform better. Fofana also explained he opted to take a penalty against Liverpool as one of the senior players on the pitch, having joined in a £75m move from Leicester City in 2022. But he confessed football had reached a stage where he was "more unhappy than happy", before recovering physically and mentally. The release of the interview has coincided with the club's poor run of form, with Chelsea losing 4-1 at home to Leeds United last weekend to make it three defeats in four matches. The defence, in particular, has come in for criticism, with the Blues one of four clubs to have conceded more than 20 goals in the Premier League after 11 matches. Having been subjected to racist abuse in the past, Fofana spoke about handling comments during a club-organised interview on this summer's pre-season tour of Asia. He is understood to be one of the highest earners at Stamford Bridge. Fofana has apologised for interview - Alonso Interviewer defends Fofana after backlash

top.title: DK Metcalf’s sign language celebration explained as he sends Aaron Rodgers message
top.description: Photo by Joe Sargent/Getty Images DK Metcalf responded in style following a difficult past week for him with a touchdown in the opening quarter against the Denver Broncos. The Pittsburgh Steelers had to return their attention to the on-field action after what has been an incredible past few days for the franchise. Wide receiver Metcalf headed into the game on Friday without his usual quarterback, Aaron Rodgers. Metcalf had only scored two touchdowns this year prior to the game against Denver, with his first-quarter score seeing him pull out an impressive sign language celebration. What DK Metcalf’s sign language celebration actually meant This is not the first time Metcalf has used this celebration in the NFL. The wideout has previously pulled a similar celebration out during his stint with the Seattle Seahawks. However, there will be very few fans who will have known the exact meaning behind it. Reporter Arye Pulli claimed Metcalf said, “Stand on business, 8″. Rodgers, of course, was number eight for the Steelers, with Metcalf seemingly showing his support for the former quarterback. Despite struggling to show it on the field, Rodgers and Metcalf had formed a strong connection since they both landed in Pittsburgh. It is a telling statement of where Metcalf’s loyalties lie when it comes to the ongoing saga between Mike McCarthy and Rodgers. As for Metcalf, it is about time he showed his worth on the field, with the receiver making three catches from his four targets inside the first half. Having narrowly avoided a suspension following his actions last week against the Philadelphia Eagles, Metcalf has said a lot without even opening his mouth when it comes to the feud between his head coach and now-former quarterback. top.title: Neemias Queta on importance of center play for Boston Celtics, NBA
top.description: According to Boston Celtics head coach Joe Mazzulla, the center position is the most important on any team in the NBA right now, and Boston big man Neemias Queta is inclined to agree. "I'm a center, so I'm a little bit biased, but the amount of responsibility that you have, the most efficient shots are at the rim," said ( via CLNS Media) the Portuguese center when asked about Mazzulla making such a claim in a recent Boston press conference. Noting how much pla on both ends of the court goes through big men in the NBA of today, Queta highlighted "being able to create as many easy looks at the rim offensively, whether it's through screening" as being critical. "Whether it's me getting the the dump downs, whether it's being able to being able to be a offensive rebounding guy and make make those shots, and then defensively deterring people from getting out there." "I think that impacts a lot of the game because everything else is tough shots, and we can we can play easier defense," added the Boston big man, who sees his success at center last season as more of a baseline than something to replicate. "This year is a new new season," he explained. "Whatever I did last year doesn't even matter anymore, so I'm just trying to build off of this season and keeping on growing off of the previous game." "But if I can have this year be like last year's ceiling, be my this year's floor, I think I'm in a good spot. And I think that's that's where I'm trying to get to and (continue) building off of that." Listen to "Airing Boston Celtics grievances, and feats of strength to fix them" on Spreaker. top.title: Liverpool receive huge injury boost ahead of Everton clash
top.description: Liverpool receive huge injury boost ahead of Everton clash Liverpool Injury Update: Victor Munoz Boost Ahead of Everton Clash Liverpool have one less problem than they feared ahead of the Merseyside derby. Victor Munoz, forced off in the 3-0 win over Club Brugge, has avoided serious injury. That matters, because Liverpool are already short of options and Andoni Iraola is still likely to be without Cody Gakpo and Ryan Gravenberch against Everton. Munoz went down after a heavy challenge at the end of a strong run in midweek. It looked awkward, enough to raise concerns about his knee, and enough for him to leave the pitch before half-time. The early signs, however, are positive. Iraola delivered the update in clear terms: “With Victor, I think the good news is that after assessing him, there is no disruption in the knee, everything is fine. But he has a big knock. It’s a big knock.” That does not guarantee availability for Sunday, but it changes the picture. A ligament issue would have meant weeks or months. A bruise means a late call. Iraola added: “He hasn’t trained today but he wants to try tomorrow. We’ll see how the bruise is. But I cannot tell you right now.” Liverpool would rather have Munoz than gamble unnecessarily, particularly in a derby where physical pressure is guaranteed from the first whistle. Photo: IMAGO Cody Gakpo absence remains clear There is less ambiguity with Gakpo. He will miss out, full stop. The forward has a calf problem picked up on international duty with the Netherlands and this will be his third consecutive missed match. Iraola was direct: “Cody definitely not [available against Everton]. It’s a muscle injury so we have to wait a little bit until the process goes on and it heals.” The timescale sounds ordinary enough, but muscle injuries rarely care for neat schedules. Iraola said: “This kind of injury is normally two or three weeks. He did it in the last [Netherlands] game against Germany, so normally it’s this timeline. But normally I don’t like to say timelines with injuries because every injury is different and some of them go quicker than others. It wasn’t a big injury but there is something there and you have to give the time to heal.” Ryan Gravenberch still struggling with heel pain Gravenberch is the more frustrating case. Heel pain sounds minor until it lingers for a month, which is exactly what has happened. He has not featured since the Carabao Cup last-16 win over Chelsea and there is still no clean return date. Iraola admitted: “It’s going to be difficult. I cannot say no because these kinds of injuries are difficult.” He explained the problem properly: “They don’t look like a big thing but you have the pain, it doesn’t go. Sometimes it’s better, you don’t know why. The next day, you come and it’s worse. He is dealing with this situation, we are trying to help him. top.title: What the Warriors are now privately saying about Draymond Green
top.description: Photo by Thearon W. Henderson/Getty Images The Golden State Warriors face a tough decision when it comes to Draymond Green’s future. Draymond Green is putting up 3.6 points, 4.8 rebounds, and 6.3 assists in the 2026-27 regular season for Golden State. His passing still moves the rock, but his discipline and decision-making have hurt the team, including a flagrant foul against San Antonio and a recent back-and-forth with Eddie Johnson after Johnson questioned his value and Hall of Fame case. With offense already hard to come by for the Warriors, critics keep asking what else he adds on the floor. Golden State Warriors open to trading Draymond Green Sam Amick, who was speaking on Sactown , says the Warriors still appreciate everything Draymond Green has done for the franchise, though they’re open to moving him if the right trade comes up. He said: “I’ve said before yes, and it’s always like you feel like you’re breaking Warriors code if you say that, but yes. “Yeah, absolutely. They’re not telling the GM on the other phone not to bring Draymond into the conversation.” Green is on an expiring deal, which makes his salary easy to move in a bigger package. Even after four rings together, other teams can bring him up without Golden State hanging up right away. He still has plenty of playoff savvy and defensive bite, but the Warriors are already short on points and he gives them next to nothing as a scorer. When buckets are that hard to come by, having a guy who doesn’t score on the floor makes things even tougher. top.description: FILE PHOTO - Werder Bremen's Niclas Füllkrug celebrates scoring his side's fourth goal during the German Bundesliga soccer match between Werder Bremen and Hamburger SV at the Weserstadion. The hosts recovered from a 3-1 deficit in what was set to be a shocking defeat to Gladbach. Kevin Diks scored Gladbach's opener from the spot in the 27th minute after a handball by Youri Regeer. Eren Dinkci equalized for Bremen in the 38th, but the guests retook the lead right after the break as Honorat completed a composed finish in the 46th. The French midfielder added a second to his name in the 78th, completing a fulminant counterattack with a stunning curler from the edge of the box. It looked like Gladbach was taking all three points until Dinkci also got himself a brace in the 85th and league's top scorer Füllkrug took advantage of a defensive mistake to equalize in the second minute of stoppage time. Ahead of the weekend's matches, Bremen remain sixth, in the qualification spot for the Conference League, while Gladbach are bottom of the table with just one win in 11 matches. "Gladbach aren't exactly where they should be in the standings. When you watch the last few games, it's been tight. Today they did well, they caused us problems," Füllkrug told broadcaster Sky. "We were careless in the way we played. We have to play a clean football, we have to bring in quality." top.title: Here's the matchup for (final?) MAC championship game at Ford Field
top.description: DETROIT — Say this much for the Mid-American Conference. It's got this parity thing down pat, at least in football. For the 14th consecutive year, there will be no repeat champion in football. Buffalo and Toledo punched their tickets to the MAC championship game with wins in their regular-season finales, Friday, Nov. 27. They will meet in the championship game Saturday, Dec. 5, at Ford Field in Detroit . Kickoff is at noon. Buffalo (9-3, 7-1) beat Akron, 17-9, on Friday, Nov. 27, while Toledo (10-2, 7-2) beat Ohio, 34-31. Buffalo is in the MAC championship game in Pete Lembo's second season as head coach, while Toledo is in the championship game in Mike Jacobs' first season as head coach. Their wins eliminated defending champion Western Michigan (8-4, 6-2) from contention. The Broncos won their fourth MAC championship in 2025, but lost their regular-season finale to Miami (Ohio), 28-24, in Kalamazoo earlier this week, and had to wait until Friday's games to see their fate. Five teams entered Friday still in contention to play in the MAC championship game, including Ohio and Miami (Ohio). Western Michigan beat Miami in last year's championship game , 23-13. The last team to repeat as MAC champion was Northern Illinois, which won in 2011 and 2012. If Buffalo beats Toledo next Saturday, the MAC championship will see a seventh different winner in the last seven years. Buffalo last won a MAC championship in 2008, while Toledo last won in 2022. Western Michigan, meanwhile, now awaits its bowl destination, while buzz continues to swirl around the future of fourth-year head coach Lance Taylor, who is in the mix for the opening at Maryland . One other Michigan Group of Six team has a chance to make a bowl game. That's Central Michigan (5-6, 3-4), which needs a victory Saturday, Nov. 28, on the road at Ball State to play in a bowl for the second time in as many seasons under head coach Matt Drinkall. Central Michigan lost to Northwestern, 34-7 , in last year's GameAbove Sports Bowl, which was discontinued after that game . Eastern Michigan's season is finished. At 5-7, 4-4, the Eagles missed a bowl game for the third straight year, and it led to the dismissal of head coach Chris Creighton after 13 seasons . EMU has never played in the MAC championship game, which might be coming to an end following next week's game. With the College Football Playoff expanding to 24 teams next season, the Power Four conference championship games are finished after 2026. The MAC hasn't yet made a decision on whether to continue playing its championship game, which has been held at Ford Field since 2004. The MAC, notably, was the one FBS college football conference to publicly push back against CFP expansion, which doesn't guarantee more than the one spot the Group of Six already receives in the 12-team CFP format. top.title: LeBron James Triple-Double Lifts Sixers Past Heat On Wednesday
top.description: Credit: Bill Streicher-Imagn Images LeBron James proved he can carry the Philadelphia 76ers even when their best player sits out. In the opening half, he made all three of his long-range shots, showing hot form. This offensive flow allowed the Sixers to control the pace against a Miami team that had won seven games in a row. Maxey Delivers When It Counts Tyrese Maxey provided the extra scoring punch the team desperately needed. With Jaylen Brown sidelined for the second half due to a hamstring injury, Maxey took over. The game ended with him scoring a team-high 30 points, plus four rebounds and six assists. According to The Lufkin Daily News , this was Maxey’s third 30-point game of the season. He was efficient on offense, hitting 12 of his 21 field goal attempts. His ability to create his own shot was vital in a game where the Sixers were short-handed. James also hit 50 percent or better from the floor in four straight contests. He is finding his rhythm quickly with this new team. The combination of James and Maxey created a scoring threat that Miami could not stop. Even without Embiid, the Sixers found a way to win a close contest. The 111-104 final score reflects how tight the game was, but the result was clear. Heat Streak Snapped in Philadelphia The loss ended Miami’s seven-game winning streak. Giannis Antetokounmpo led the Heat with 32 points and 14 rebounds, but it was not enough. Davion Mitchell tallied 20 points alongside 10 assists, whereas Bam Adebayo notched 17 points and 11 rebounds. The Heat now sit at 2-1 in NBA Cup play, just like the Sixers. Both teams have one game remaining in their group. The Miami Heat face New York, the defending NBA Cup champion, in Friday night’s Group B final. The Sixers will look to build on this momentum as they continue their push for the title.

top.title: Raiders’ Jackson Powers-Johnson suffers potentially serious injury at practice
top.description: An already-frustrating season for Raiders offensive lineman Jackson Powers-Johnson took an ominous turn Friday when he suffered a potentially serious injury during practice. Powers-Johnson was ruled out for Sunday’s game against the Browns and could be sidelined considerably longer. “He had an injury at practice today, and we’ll have more details for you tomorrow,” Raiders coach Klint Kubiak said Friday. Las Vegas Raiders quarterback Fernando Mendoza (15) celebrates a touchdown with Jackson Powers-Johnson (58) and Connor Heyward (34) in Las Vegas, Nov. 15, 2026. AP Photo/David Becker Asked if the injury was serious, Kubiak acknowledged the possibility. “Could be, yes,” Kubiak said. “We’ll go take a peek at him here after this and have more info for you.” It’s the latest setback for a player whose first three NFL seasons have fallen short of the lofty expectations that accompanied his arrival in Las Vegas. Jackson Powers-Johnson of the Las Vegas Raiders arrives at Allegiant Stadium in Las Vegas on Sunday, Nov. 15, 2026, for a game against the Seattle Seahawks. Getty Images The Raiders selected Powers-Johnson with the 44th overall pick in the second round of the 2024 NFL Draft out of Oregon, where he won the Rimington Trophy as college football’s best center. The expectation was that Powers-Johnson would become a foundational piece along the Raiders’ offensive line, either at center or guard. Instead, injuries and an inability to establish himself as a permanent starter have prevented that from materializing. Powers-Johnson started 14 games as a rookie, splitting time between left guard and center. His second season was cut short by an ankle injury. Las Vegas Raiders head coach Klint Kubiak speaks during a news conference after an NFL football game in Denver, Sunday, Nov. 22, 2026. AP Photo/David Zalubowski The offseason signing of Tyler Linderbaum effectively closed the door on Powers-Johnson becoming the Raiders’ long-term answer at center. And he has been unable to maintain a firm grip on the starting right guard job. Now, depending on the severity of Friday’s injury, Powers-Johnson could face yet another obstacle in his effort to establish himself as part of the Raiders’ future, with next season representing the final year of his rookie contract.

Adeola said, “I want to commend the Honourable Justice for his erudite judgment in these cases challenging my overwhelming and widely accepted victory in our party primary. I also commend my legal team for the painstaking defense put up during the process. “This victory is yet another milestone in our quest for equity and justice in the Ogun State 2027 election. To God be the glory once again.” The senator said that despite the legal challenges, he had remained focused on consolidating support for his candidacy across the state through engagements with political stakeholders and other interest groups. He added that his engagements had also included the presentation of his nine-pillar ITESIWAJU Agenda, which he described as his development blueprint for Ogun State. According to him, the court’s decision would allow him to concentrate more fully on preparations for the 2027 governorship election and take his campaign message to voters across the state. Adeola also urged APC members and his supporters, irrespective of their political affiliations, to remain united and focused, stressing that his ambition was driven by a desire to serve the people and contribute to the development of Ogun State. nigeria.title: Two Nigerians arrested over romance scam in Thailand
nigeria.description: Two Nigerian men have been arrested in Thailand over their alleged links to an international romance scam network targeting victims across Southeast Asia. The suspects, aged 41 and 30, were arrested on November 18 at a condominium in Ban Mai, Pak Kret district, Nonthaburi, following an investigation by Thailand’s Immigration Division 3 and Provincial Police Region 1. According to local media outlet, The Thaiger, undercover police officers disguised themselves as food delivery workers to gain access to the suspects’ apartment. With the help of security guards, the officers approached the condominium and pretended to have a parcel for delivery. When one of the men opened the door, they identified themselves as police officers and moved in to arrest both suspects. A search of the apartment reportedly led to the recovery of laptops and mobile phones containing messages linked to fake online identities posing as US military personnel. Investigators suspect the identities were used to establish romantic relationships with potential victims as part of an international scam operation. Police also reportedly found social media accounts allegedly created to deceive Thai residents. The arrests followed an earlier investigation on November 12, when police detained another Nigerian man, aged 37, at Owl Market in Nonthaburi over suspected links to the same network. Investigators later searched a condominium in Bang Kraso, Mueang Nonthaburi, where suspected members of the group had reportedly stayed. However, the men had left before the search. Police subsequently traced the two suspects to another condominium in the Muang Thong Thani area, where they were believed to have stayed for two to three days before their arrest. The Thaiger reported that both men confessed during questioning. However, the charges publicly reported against them are immigration-related offences, including illegal entry and unauthorised residence. One of the suspects, aged 41, had reportedly overstayed his permitted stay in Thailand by 411 days. Authorities revoked their permission to remain in the country and transferred them to Pak Kret Police Station for further legal proceedings ahead of deportation. The investigation into the suspected romance scam network is ongoing. Thai police have not disclosed the identities of the alleged victims, the amount of money involved or the specific roles the two men allegedly played in the operation. The reported immigration charges do not amount to convictions for romance fraud. The post Two Nigerians arrested over romance scam in Thailand appeared first on Vanguard News .

nigeria.title: Adesua Etomi celebrates negative cancer test
nigeria.description: Nollywood actress Adesua Etomi-Wellington has celebrated testing negative for cancer after months of medical procedures, hospital visits and uncertainty over her health. The actress announced the development on Friday in an Instagram video, expressing gratitude to God following the latest result from her medical tests. “The doctor just called me back with the result from the lab, no cancer… God is good,” she said. The video showed some of the medical procedures she underwent, while other pictures revealed bruises on her body and redness beneath one of her eyes. Etomi-Wellington also shared a video of friends and well-wishers celebrating the result with her. Reflecting on her experience, the actress described 2026 as one of the most difficult periods of her life, explaining that her reduced public appearances were linked to her health struggles. “2026 really tried it. I know I’ve been quieter than usual this year (and that’s saying something), but behind the silence were some of the most difficult months of my life,” she wrote. She disclosed that the ordeal involved several medical procedures, scans, injections and hospital visits, adding that she received treatment from medical teams in Nigeria and the United States. “This year threw everything at me, but by the grace of God, I am NOT EASILY BROKEN,” she added. The actress also expressed appreciation to her husband, singer and politician Bankole Wellington, popularly known as Banky W, their children, friends and family members for supporting her throughout the difficult period. “To my friends and family who prayed for me, stood in the gap and held me through some of my darkest days, I will never take your love for granted,” she wrote. The health update comes two days after the couple released a gospel song, On My Way , on November 25 to celebrate their ninth wedding anniversary. The track, credited to Etomi-Wellington, who performs under the musical name Susu, and Banky W, is the lead single from their forthcoming joint album, Not Easily Broken , expected in 2027. The actress described the song as “the soundtrack to our testimony and thanksgiving”, linking its message to their personal experiences. The couple have previously spoken about their health challenges. In May 2024, Banky W disclosed that he had undergone his fourth surgery for cancer after earlier procedures to remove cancerous tumours. Etomi-Wellington also revealed in March 2025 that she battled hyperemesis gravidarum, a severe form of pregnancy sickness, during her second pregnancy. nigeria.title: UK lists two conditions for bringing goods into country without paying tax
nigeria.description: The United Kingdom government has outlined two conditions under which travellers can bring goods into the country without paying customs duty or tax, warning that items outside the permitted categories or allowance limits could attract charges. According to the UK government’s customs guidelines, travellers can bring goods into the country tax-free under two conditions. First condition is personal use. Goods must be intended for the traveller’s own use rather than for commercial purposes or resale. Second condition is gifts. Travellers can also bring goods intended as presents for other people without paying customs duty, provided they remain within the applicable personal allowance. The rules apply to foreign visitors and British residents returning from overseas, regardless of whether the items were purchased from regular shops or duty-free outlets at airports. However, the exemptions are subject to personal allowance limits, which determine the quantity and value of goods travellers can bring into the country without incurring additional charges. The applicable allowance depends on where a traveller is arriving from and whether the destination is Great Britain, comprising England, Scotland and Wales, or Northern Ireland. The government also warned that goods intended for business or resale do not qualify for personal allowances. Such items must be declared to customs regardless of their value or quantity. Travellers are also required to declare goods that exceed their personal allowances or fall under banned and restricted categories before crossing the border. Declarations can be made online up to five days, or 120 hours, before arrival in the UK. The authorities warned that failure to comply with customs regulations could result in the seizure of goods and, in some cases, the vehicle used to transport them. Offenders may also face financial penalties or prosecution. The post UK lists two conditions for bringing goods into country without paying tax appeared first on Vanguard News .

nigeria.title: mRNA Ebola vaccine trial launched in Uganda
nigeria.description: Trials of an experimental Ebola vaccine launched in Uganda on Friday, while a global NGO said it had bought 1.5 million doses of another candidate, as the race heats up to contain the outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo. There are currently no vaccines or treatments for the less common Bundibugyo strain of Ebola behind the outbreak in DRC, which has caused more than 5,700 confirmed deaths out of more than 11,000 cases since being declared in May, according to the World Health Organization (WHO). Two experimental vaccines are due to start testing on Monday in the outbreak’s epicentre in eastern DRC, the WHO said, focusing on contacts of cases and people deemed at high risk of infection. But neighbouring Uganda announced it had also launched a trial of one of the vaccines, developed by the US-based Moderna group using the mRNA technology made famous during the Covid pandemic. The Uganda Virus Research Institute described it as “Africa’s first mRNA Phase I clinical trial”, conducted in collaboration with Moderna. It will test 224 healthy volunteers aged between one and 65 to measure its safety and immunity potential. The other potential vaccine is the ChAdOx1 adenoviral vector vaccine developed by India’s Serum Institute and the University of Oxford — which will also begin testing in DRC on Monday. But Gavi, the Vaccine Alliance, which brings together government and private donors to help developing countries acquire jabs at affordable prices, is not waiting around. After the Covid-19 pandemic, the alliance set up a new $50 million First Response Fund — under a so-called “No Regrets” approach — to allow it to buy up doses in advance even before they have been fully tested. – Deployment – Gavi signed a purchase commitment this week with the Serum Institute for 1.5 million doses of the ChAdOx1, and plans to have “hundreds of thousands” ready to deploy should the trials prove successful and they are approved by the WHO and DRC government. “We’re investing in it, hoping that the signals will be positive, and if that is the case, we’ll have gained months and months on the deployment,” Emanuele Capobianco, Gavi’s director of global health security, told AFP. He said he hoped for trials to conclude “within the first half of 2027” and even “within the first quarter” in a more optimistic scenario. Gavi also has a stockpile of 500,000 doses of an existing vaccine, Ervebo, used against the Zaire strain of Ebola, which began testing last month to see if it is also effective against Bundibugyo. Despite a long and porous border with eastern DRC, Uganda has successfully contained the virus after receiving some imported cases earlier this year. The Director-General of the National Sports Commission (NSC), Bukola Olopade, disclosed this in a video shared on his X handle on Friday, saying Nigeria had already communicated its interest to the Confederation of African Football (CAF). According to Olopade, the country expressed its desire to host the competition during CAF’s General Assembly held in Abuja last weekend. “We have said to CAF that we are desirous of hosting the first Under-17 women’s championship,” he said. He explained that the move forms part of Nigeria’s ambition to move away from what he described as a consuming sports economy towards a productive one, where hosting international events would generate economic benefits for the country. “We don’t want to be a consuming sports economy; rather, we want to be a productive sports economy. We want to attract more international events where the economic impacts will be felt by the people,” Olopade added. CAF’s Executive Committee approved the introduction of the U-17 WAFCON on November 21, with the inaugural tournament scheduled to take place between March and April 2028. Qualifying matches are expected to begin in April 2027. Nigeria’s interest in hosting the competition comes amid discussions about the country’s readiness to stage major international football events. Earlier this week, FIFA President Gianni Infantino said Nigeria was not yet ready to host the men’s FIFA World Cup, although he acknowledged the country’s resources, passion and willingness to stage the competition. Infantino, however, suggested that Nigeria could demonstrate its organisational capacity by hosting smaller international football tournaments before taking on events of greater magnitude. The proposed U-17 WAFCON could therefore provide Nigeria with an opportunity to showcase its capacity to organise a continental football competition. nigeria.title: Hackers breach US Air Force Cloud computing platform
nigeria.description: Hackers have breached Cloud One, the United States Air Force’s flagship cloud computing platform, potentially exposing sensitive military, personnel and logistics data. Three people familiar with the matter told Reuters that the intrusion was discovered within the past month during efforts to upgrade the system, triggering disruptions across the platform. However, the identity of the hackers, the full extent of the breach and whether any data was stolen remain unknown. In a statement to Reuters, the US Air Force declined to discuss the security status of specific networks and systems. It said: “We continuously take prudent measures to protect Department (of the Air Force) information, systems and mission capabilities.” A major military computing platform Launched in 2017, Cloud One was designed as a centralised platform for the Air Force’s information technology needs, bringing together services provided by four major technology companies: Microsoft, Amazon, Oracle and Alphabet. The platform supports dozens of applications, including systems managing personnel records, salaries, logistics and military equipment maintenance. Among the applications hosted on Cloud One are the Air Force’s Cloud-Based Command and Control system, which consolidates air defence radar and other data feeds across North America, and the Theatre Integrated Combat Munitions System, which tracks bombs and missiles at more than 200 US Air Force locations worldwide. Cloud One is regarded as one of the US military’s largest cloud computing platforms, according to two sources familiar with the matter. “A breach here is a big deal,” one of the sources told Reuters. Investigators have reportedly involved US Cyber Command, the military’s cyber warfare arm, to assess the damage. Science Applications International Corporation (SAIC) served as the platform’s prime contractor until 2025, when Leidos took over the contract. SAIC did not respond to Reuters’ request for comment, while Leidos referred questions to the Air Force. Breach disrupts military operations The intrusion has reportedly triggered several disruptions across the platform. Two sources and another person familiar with the matter said plans to migrate additional back-office applications to Cloud One, a longstanding military priority, had been suspended. Updates to applications already running on the platform were also blocked, preventing Air Force personnel from installing fixes, even as new software vulnerabilities were being disclosed across the technology industry. Another source said some users had their administrator privileges revoked. One of the sources said the hackers exploited a software vulnerability to gain access to the platform’s control plane, which manages and oversees the underlying cloud infrastructure. The source likened the control plane to a universal remote, explaining that access could theoretically allow intruders to check the operational status of military aircraft or monitor the movement of spare

nigeria.title: France slips into ‘technical recession’ after GDP revision
nigeria.description: France’s economy has slipped into a technical recession after revised official figures showed that gross domestic product (GDP) contracted in the third quarter, extending the country’s economic decline. The National Institute of Statistics and Economic Studies (INSEE) said on Friday that the eurozone’s second-largest economy shrank by 0.2 per cent in the third quarter, revising its initial estimate of a 0.1 per cent contraction. The agency also revised second-quarter growth downwards to 0.02 per cent from zero per cent previously, although the figure was rounded to zero in the headline data. The revisions mean France’s economy has recorded consecutive quarterly contractions since the end of last year, meeting the conventional definition of a technical recession, which is two successive quarters of negative economic growth. The latest figures pose additional challenges for the government as it struggles to rein in the country’s budget deficit, with its target of 0.5 per cent economic growth this year now appearing increasingly difficult to achieve. The minority government is also facing difficulties securing parliamentary approval for its 2027 budget, which seeks to reduce the fiscal deficit from 5.4 per cent of GDP this year to five per cent next year. The budget debate comes five months before France’s presidential election, amid deep divisions in parliament. Reacting to the figures, Finance Minister Roland Lescure called for the speedy adoption of the budget, insisting that the five per cent deficit target was non-negotiable. “We must adopt a budget as soon as possible with a non-negotiable deficit target of 5%. It is imperative that we restore visibility for economic stakeholders,” he said. A breakdown of the third-quarter GDP figures by INSEE showed that weak domestic demand contributed to the contraction. Consumer spending rose by 0.3 per cent, but this was offset by a 0.8 per cent decline in business investment. The rebuilding of business inventories contributed 0.3 percentage points to GDP growth, following a 0.7 percentage-point reduction in the previous quarter. Foreign trade also weighed heavily on economic performance, subtracting 0.6 percentage points from output as exports fell by 1.6 per cent while imports increased by 0.1 per cent. Despite the contraction, the Bank of France said earlier in November that the economy was expected to record moderate growth in the fourth quarter. nigeria.title: Kebbi Police probe alleged importation of political thugs

The command also said it had invited three persons mentioned in the video for questioning over the circumstances surrounding the presence of the suspected thugs in Kebbi State. The Police Public Relations Officer, SP Bashir Usman, disclosed this in a statement on Friday, saying intelligence reports and preliminary scrutiny of the video identified one “Mai Barewa”, described as a notorious thug from Sokoto State, alongside other individuals wielding dangerous weapons and making threatening statements. According to Usman, the individuals were heard in the video claiming to have responded to an invitation and mentioning three persons identified as Manu Gwanna, Bashar S. A. and Khairullah Jega in connection with their presence in the state. He described the threats, particularly those directed at individuals perceived not to support the ruling party, as a potential recipe for political violence. The police spokesman said the persons mentioned and identified in the video had been invited to assist the ongoing investigation, while the command was taking steps to identify, apprehend and prosecute Mai Barewa and his accomplices. He said the police would ensure that anyone found culpable was dealt with in accordance with the law. The command reiterated its commitment to political neutrality, impartial law enforcement and the protection of all citizens, irrespective of their political affiliations. It warned that no political party, individual or group would be allowed to undermine peaceful electioneering, intimidate citizens or engage in violence under the guise of political activities. The statement noted that Kebbi had long enjoyed a peaceful political climate, which must be preserved ahead of the 2027 general elections. Consequently, the police warned political parties, their leaders, supporters and associates against recruiting, harbouring, mobilising or sponsoring suspected imported thugs, or engaging in any conduct capable of inciting violence and disrupting political stability. The command further warned that it would not allow political violence, intimidation and lawlessness to take root in the state or set a dangerous precedent ahead of the 2027 elections. It urged residents to remain calm, refrain from taking the law into their own hands and promptly report suspicious activities to the nearest police station or through the command’s designated communication channels. The police assured residents of its commitment to maintaining peace, protecting lives and property, and ensuring that all political activities in the state are conducted within the ambit of the law. business.description: Bitcoin Magazine Binance Fully Lifts Withdrawal Suspension a Month After $6.3 Billion Hack Binance has fully lifted the withdrawal suspension it put in place after last month’s record $6.3 billion hack, saying its recovery work is complete and that withdrawals are open across nearly all networks. “Our withdrawal recovery work is completed and the withdrawal suspension from the security incident has been fully lifted,” the exchange said in an X post Thursday afternoon. A small number of networks remain paused for maintenance, which Binance called standard practice and said was unrelated to the hack. The update closes out a month of phased reopenings. Binance confirmed the breach on Oct. 29, saying its initial investigation pointed to a compromised DevOps engineer’s laptop that gave the attacker access to a service container, which was then used to submit unauthorized withdrawals. The world’s largest crypto exchange stopped all customer withdrawals for two days after the theft, Reuters reported . When they first reopened, customers pulled a net $4.7 billion off the platform, Binance said on Nov. 2. Binance covered the losses Binance said on Nov. 12 that it had completed coverage of the affected assets with more than $6.34 billion of company funds. The money came from a partial draw on its Secure Asset Fund for Users, part of its futures insurance fund and its corporate treasury, and the exchange pledged to rebuild SAFU to about $1 billion. Coverage is not the same as recovery. Binance replaced the stolen tokens from its own books, while about $2.85 billion of the stolen funds have been frozen remotely by the companies that issue them. The rest remains in the hands of the attackers. U.S. authorities have blamed North Korean hackers for the theft, which North Korea denies. On Nov. 23, the Justice Department moved to forfeit more than $1.1 billion in USDC that Circle froze, and said the U.S. has helped freeze, seize or return more than $2.9 billion since the attack. Launderers turn to THORChain and coinjoin The unfrozen funds are on the move. North Korean launderers have stepped up transfers through THORChain and a coinjoin service in recent days, blockchain researchers told Reuters , as part of an operation spanning tens of thousands of transactions across blockchains. TRM Labs estimates THORChain earned as much as $1 million in fees from the swaps. Separately, $342 million has moved through a coinjoin service mostly coordinated by a pseudonymous figure named Kruw, Elliptic said. A coinjoin combines coins from many users into a single transaction, so their origin is no longer visible on the blockchain. business.description: Bitcoin Magazine Russia’s VTB Opens Bitcoin Trading as Central Bank Finalizes Crypto Test Russian bank VTB began letting brokerage clients buy and sell bitcoin in its investing app on Friday, a day after the Bank of Russia approved the knowledge test every Russian crypto buyer now has to pass. Starting Nov. 27, clients of VTB’s brokerage can trade cryptocurrencies in the VTB My Investments app, the broker said . For now, the trades happen over the counter rather than on an exchange, and access is limited to qualified investors, the legal term for Russians who meet wealth or experience thresholds, who also pass the new test. “In our model, access to cryptocurrencies will require qualified investor status and passing special testing,” Andrei Yatskov, head of brokerage services at VTB, said . He said the test would appear in the app on Nov. 27 and work like the bank’s existing tests for other instruments. VTB handles the buying, storage and record-keeping itself on Russian infrastructure. To trade, clients need to open a separate digital account at VTB’s digital depository, where the crypto is held, on top of their regular brokerage account. The bank received its digital depository and crypto exchange licenses on Oct. 6. “At the start, we will focus on buying and selling cryptocurrencies, and then we will introduce additional services as regulation develops,” Yatskov said. Eight questions before the first trade The launch came quickly after the regulator moved. On Nov. 26, the Bank of Russia approved the first basic standards for brokers and crypto exchange offices, setting the rules for the test. Every investor has to take it, qualified or not, and it is free. Buyers must answer at least seven of eight questions correctly. The standard lays out eight topic blocks, from regulation, technical basics and information security to stablecoins, low-liquidity coins, address labeling and blocked transactions, and volatility, with one question drawn at random from each. Investors who fail can try once more the same day, with different questions. Brokers are barred from sharing the correct answers with clients or telling them which questions they missed. A passing result stays valid for one year from the test date or the latest trade, whichever comes later. The test was the missing piece for Russian banks. When retail buying became legal on Nov. 17 , T-Bank said it was waiting on a market standard for testing, and VTB said it was waiting on the remaining rules. Under the broker standard, the industry’s self-regulatory organization has three working days after publication to send brokers the answer options and correct answers. Ordinary investors still face tight limits once they pass. Non-qualified buyers can only purchase bitcoin, ether and Tether’s USDT, and no more than 300,000 rubles a year through a single intermediary. SPB Exchange sets Dec. 1 start Exchange trading is next. business.description: Bitcoin Magazine New York Wins $1.37 Billion Judgment Against NovaTech Crypto Ponzi Founders A New York judge has ordered the founders of NovaTech, a cryptocurrency investment scheme that targeted Haitian communities, to pay more than $1.37 billion, closing out the state’s case against a couple who fled the country rather than answer it. Justice Anar Rathod Patel of the New York County Supreme Court signed the order on Nov. 24. It holds Cynthia and Eddy Petion and their companies NovaTech Ltd, NovaTech Advisors and NovaPay jointly liable for $1,367,023,585 in disgorgement and interest. New York Attorney General Letitia James announced the win on Wednesday. “Today’s historic judgment finally delivers some semblance of justice for the thousands of New Yorkers who were targeted by this merciless scam,” James said. “NovaTech cruelly targeted immigrant families through faith and community groups with the promise of a better life while robbing them of their life savings.” Where the $1.37 billion figure comes from The award matches what the attorney general’s office asked for in October . The figure starts with the cryptocurrency investors sent to NovaTech’s wallet at payment processor CoinPayments, which totaled about $1.16 billion from August 2019 through May 2023, according to an affirmation filed by the state. Prosecutors subtracted the roughly $26 million NovaTech actually moved to its trading platform, leaving $1.13 billion in principal. Nine percent annual interest from June 2023 through September 2025 added another $232.5 million. NovaTech’s traders lost about $18.2 million of the money they did trade, the filing said. Everything else paid out of the wallet, including so-called returns and recruitment bonuses, came from other investors’ deposits. Cynthia Petion was the only authorized user on the CoinPayments account, and the state says she approved at least $134.5 million in crypto withdrawals to wallets belonging to her and her husband. The judge also ordered the Petions’ earlier venture, AWS Mining, to pay about $1.46 million. Cynthia Petion owes a separate $4.69 million tied to her promotion of that scheme. A NovaTech scheme built on prayer groups AWS Mining sold crypto mining contracts and promised 15% to 20% monthly returns before it collapsed in 2019, according to the attorney general’s office. Promoters recruited through prayer groups, WhatsApp chats and ads in Haitian Creole. NovaTech collapsed in May 2023, and tens of thousands of investors couldn’t withdraw their crypto. The state sued in June 2024. The Petions never answered the complaint. business.description: Bitcoin Magazine Bitcoin Price Trades Near $61,300 as Tech Stock Futures Rally The bitcoin price traded near $61,300 on Friday morning, as tech stock futures jumped ahead of a holiday-shortened session on Wall Street. Bitcoin price is on track for its first weekly gain after seven straight weekly losses, though it is still down about 20% in November. The bitcoin price was up about 1.7% early Friday and set to add 4.8% for the week, Investing.com reported , extending a recovery from a two-year low of $57,325.70 hit earlier in the week. Bitcoin slumped below $57,500 on Wednesday as the Nasdaq sank at the open, before a late rebound in tech shares lifted risk assets. Short sellers helped fuel the bounce. Shorts made up 77% of $84.7 million in bitcoin liquidations over the past day, while futures open interest was little changed. That suggests forced short covering, rather than fresh leverage, supplied much of the lift. Tech futures lead the risk rebound Nasdaq 100 futures rose 2.2% by 6:42 a.m. ET, Reuters reported, as investors returned from Thanksgiving and piled back into battered AI-linked shares. Nvidia gained 3.6% in premarket trading, while AMD climbed 4.4% and Broadcom added 3.4%. S&P 500 futures rose 1.6%, and Dow futures gained 1.3%. “There have been some signs that the tech selloff has stabilised for now, and that risk appetite is returning to markets,” Deutsche Bank analysts said in a note cited by Reuters. The S&P 500 is headed for its best week since April, though it remains on course for its worst November since 2008. Bitcoin price has followed that rebound but lagged it. The major U.S. stock indexes are each up around 4% on the week, and silver jumped about 7% to above $44 an ounce on Friday while gold added 2.5% to above $3,670. business.description: Bitcoin Magazine Galaxy Withdraws Call That Bitcoin’s Bear Market Ended in June Galaxy has withdrawn its October call that bitcoin’s bear market ended in June, saying the technical signal behind it failed after seven straight weeks of losses and that the bear market is “very likely not over.” Alex Thorn, Galaxy’s head of firmwide research, laid out the reversal in a report published Wednesday and sent to clients a day earlier. “We withdraw our call that the bear market ended in June,” the report said. “The signal it rested on has failed.” The firm’s Oct. 26 note had argued that bitcoin had entered an accumulation phase. Galaxy said at the time that a weekly close back below the 50-week moving average that was not regained within a month would invalidate its technical case. That is what happened. Bitcoin closed the week ended Nov. 8 at $74,968, 0.7% below the 50-week average, after seven weekly closes above it. It then closed the week ended Nov. 15 below the 200-week average, which Galaxy has described as the floor of past bear markets. Galaxy points to $58,525 The week ended Nov. 22 closed at $61,104, 17.9% below the 50-week average and 10.4% below the 200-week average of $68,159. Bitcoin traded below its July 1 intraday low on Nov. 20 and reached $55,100 on Nov. 21, but the June 30 closing low of $58,525 held on a daily basis through Nov. 22. Galaxy now treats that level as the line to watch. A daily close below $58,525 would be “the start of a move to a materially lower low,” the report said, and the firm would not treat such a close as a buying signal by itself. History is not kind to breaks like that. In the seven prior bear market cases where bitcoin closed below a low that had stood for at least 60 days, the eventual low was at least 17% lower, with a median of 52%. Applied to the June low, that works out to about $48,500 and $28,200. Bitcoin briefly slumped below $57,500 on Wednesday morning as the Nasdaq sank, but it ended the day back above $60,000 and has not posted a daily close below $58,525. By the calendar, this bear is old: Nov. 22 was day 412 since the Oct. 6, 2025, record, longer than the 163 to 406 days from high to low in the four prior bear markets. By depth, it looks unfinished. entertainment.title: Israel Olaleye: How Can Young Nigerians Buy Land & Properties Legitimately Today?
entertainment.description: Young man with a hard hat holding a red for sale sign outside a building by Pavel Danilyuk for Pexels . My parents’ generation mostly bought land the way their parents did. Someone in the family knew someone in the village. An uncle walked the boundaries. The community remembered who owned what, and if anything went wrong, you had a face to go back to. However, my generation buys land on Instagram. I do not say that to mock anyone. I sell land for a living. When I started in real estate sales in 2023, two years after finishing a Mathematics degree at the University of Ibadan, I assumed buyers would care most about price and location. They do care. But what I hear most often is fear, dressed up as questions. Can I trust you? Is this land real? What happens if I miss a payment? After I pay, will someone come and ask me for more money? A prospective buyer once asked me, before anything else, whether community or family payments would follow after she paid for her plot. She was not asking about the land. She was asking whether the price I quoted was the real price. She had good reason to ask. Lagos State’s Property Protection Law of 2016 made it an offence to demand levies for construction on someone else’s property. Yet the same law still allows a land-owning family, with the family head’s authority, to collect a customary fee for possession, the payment many people know as a “foundation levy”. So the honest answer to her question is not a simple yes or no. It depends on the land, the family, and what has been written down. Most first-time buyers have never been told any of this. That is the gap I keep coming back to. Nobody taught us how to buy land. We learned how to save. Some of us learned how to invest in stocks, crypto or a side business. But land, the asset our parents spoke about with the most respect, has no manual. The people who used to stand in for the manual–the uncle, the community, the family lawyer everyone trusted–are often not part of how we buy anymore. So we improvise. A prospect once told me she had gone through my Instagram page carefully before she agreed to speak with me. entertainment.title: As Nigeria Rethinks Teacher Education, Tunji Olowolafe Makes a Case for Better-Prepared Educators
entertainment.description: What makes a good teacher? Beyond knowing a subject, a good teacher can understand students, inspire confidence, and help young people discover what they are capable of becoming. It was this broader responsibility of educators that Dr. Tunji Olowolafe explored while delivering the 2026 Convocation Lecture at the Sikiru Adetona College of Education, Science and Technology (SACOETEC), Omu-Ajose, Ogun State. Speaking on Monday, 23 November 2026, on the theme “The Dual-Mandate NCE-Degree Programme: Prospects, Challenges and the Future of Teacher Education in Nigeria,” he described the programme as an important opportunity to reposition teacher education. For decades, Colleges of Education depended on university affiliations to award Bachelor’s degrees, despite many possessing the academic capacity to run such programmes. The Federal Colleges of Education Act 2023 changed this, empowering eligible institutions to award degrees independently. Under the Dual-Mandate programme, students can complete three years of NCE training and proceed to another two years for a Bachelor’s degree in Education. Dr. Olowolafe explained that combining practical teaching skills with deeper academic knowledge would produce better-prepared educators. However, he cautioned that institutional autonomy must be supported by sustained funding, improved curricula and professional development. With Nigeria facing an estimated shortage of one million teachers, he also called for greater integration of vocational education, artificial intelligence and digital skills into learning. “AI can explain a quadratic equation at midnight, but it cannot offer the steady, empathetic guidance of a caring adult,” he said, emphasizing that artificial intelligence must complement, not replace, the human qualities of effective teaching. During the lecture, Dr. Olowolafe announced that the Tunji Olowolafe Foundation would establish a fully equipped, solar-powered Gbemisola Olowolafe Memorial ICT Centre (GOMTECH) with high-speed internet connectivity at SACOETEC. The Foundation is also committed to recognising academic excellence and outstanding teaching at the College. This includes recognising the College’s first-class degree graduates and NCE distinction holders, alongside the overall best NCE and degree graduates. Lecturers, selected based on student ratings, will also be honoured for their teaching contributions. The initiative builds on the Foundation’s existing investment in education, including Project Digi-Teach at Ekiti State University and GOMTECH in Are-Ekiti. For Dr. Olowolafe, the commitment to educators is also deeply personal. His mother was a teacher, his elder sister taught for years at Baptist Academy, Lagos, and his late wife, Gbemisola Olowolafe, was a lifelong educator. sports.title: 'You're not welcome here' - Chelsea's Fofana booed by own fans
sports.description: Wesley Fofana has made 10 appearances for Chelsea this season. [Getty Images] Chelsea defender Wesley Fofana was subjected to repeated boos and told "you're not welcome here" by his own fans during Friday's Premier League defeat by Nottingham Forest. The jeers aimed at the 25-year-old were heard every time he touched the ball and came after an unauthorised interview with French YouTuber Zach Nani was released. In that controversial two-hour conversation, Fofana also appeared to joke about missing his penalty during last month's Carabao Cup shootout defeat by Liverpool. Manager Xabi Alonso said the French centre-back had apologised and "it won't be repeated". But Fofana endured a difficult time in his side's trip to Forest as supporters made their feelings known. After Chelsea went behind to a brilliant volley from Igor Jesus in the fifth minute, Fofana also conceded a penalty for the home side's second goal from Morgan Gibbs-White in the 51st minute. He was booked for the foul on Liam Delap in the box, and then replaced by Levi Colwill in the 56th minute - just after Emmanuel Emegha had pulled a goal back for the visitors - before Gibbs-White made it 3-1 in the 72nd minute. Emegha scored again in the 89th minute to make it 3-2, but Forest held on to secure their first win over Chelsea at the City Ground since 1997. Meanwhile, Nani has moved to defend Fofana, saying the player was "clearly" not happy during the interview and admitted he had to perform better. Fofana also explained he opted to take a penalty against Liverpool as one of the senior players on the pitch, having joined in a £75m move from Leicester City in 2022. But he confessed football had reached a stage where he was "more unhappy than happy", before recovering physically and mentally. The release of the interview has coincided with the club's poor run of form, with Chelsea losing 4-1 at home to Leeds United last weekend to make it three defeats in four matches. The defence, in particular, has come in for criticism, with the Blues one of four clubs to have conceded more than 20 goals in the Premier League after 11 matches. Having been subjected to racist abuse in the past, Fofana spoke about handling comments during a club-organised interview on this summer's pre-season tour of Asia. sports.description: Liverpool receive huge injury boost ahead of Everton clash Liverpool Injury Update: Victor Munoz Boost Ahead of Everton Clash Liverpool have one less problem than they feared ahead of the Merseyside derby. Victor Munoz, forced off in the 3-0 win over Club Brugge, has avoided serious injury. That matters, because Liverpool are already short of options and Andoni Iraola is still likely to be without Cody Gakpo and Ryan Gravenberch against Everton. Munoz went down after a heavy challenge at the end of a strong run in midweek. It looked awkward, enough to raise concerns about his knee, and enough for him to leave the pitch before half-time. The early signs, however, are positive. Iraola delivered the update in clear terms: “With Victor, I think the good news is that after assessing him, there is no disruption in the knee, everything is fine. But he has a big knock. It’s a big knock.” That does not guarantee availability for Sunday, but it changes the picture. A ligament issue would have meant weeks or months. A bruise means a late call. Iraola added: “He hasn’t trained today but he wants to try tomorrow. We’ll see how the bruise is. But I cannot tell you right now.” Liverpool would rather have Munoz than gamble unnecessarily, particularly in a derby where physical pressure is guaranteed from the first whistle. Photo: IMAGO Cody Gakpo absence remains clear There is less ambiguity with Gakpo. He will miss out, full stop. The forward has a calf problem picked up on international duty with the Netherlands and this will be his third consecutive missed match. Iraola was direct: “Cody definitely not [available against Everton]. It’s a muscle injury so we have to wait a little bit until the process goes on and it heals.” The timescale sounds ordinary enough, but muscle injuries rarely care for neat schedules. Iraola said: “This kind of injury is normally two or three weeks. He did it in the last [Netherlands] game against Germany, so normally it’s this timeline. It wasn’t a big injury but there is something there and you have to give the time to heal.” Ryan Gravenberch still struggling with heel pain Gravenberch is the more frustrating case. sports.description: DETROIT — Say this much for the Mid-American Conference. It's got this parity thing down pat, at least in football. For the 14th consecutive year, there will be no repeat champion in football. Buffalo and Toledo punched their tickets to the MAC championship game with wins in their regular-season finales, Friday, Nov. 27. They will meet in the championship game Saturday, Dec. 5, at Ford Field in Detroit . Kickoff is at noon. Buffalo is in the MAC championship game in Pete Lembo's second season as head coach, while Toledo is in the championship game in Mike Jacobs' first season as head coach. Their wins eliminated defending champion Western Michigan (8-4, 6-2) from contention. The Broncos won their fourth MAC championship in 2025, but lost their regular-season finale to Miami (Ohio), 28-24, in Kalamazoo earlier this week, and had to wait until Friday's games to see their fate. Five teams entered Friday still in contention to play in the MAC championship game, including Ohio and Miami (Ohio). Western Michigan beat Miami in last year's championship game , 23-13. The last team to repeat as MAC champion was Northern Illinois, which won in 2011 and 2012. If Buffalo beats Toledo next Saturday, the MAC championship will see a seventh different winner in the last seven years. Buffalo last won a MAC championship in 2008, while Toledo last won in 2022. James also hit 50 percent or better from the floor in four straight contests. He is finding his rhythm quickly with this new team. The combination of James and Maxey created a scoring threat that Miami could not stop. Even without Embiid, the Sixers found a way to win a close contest. The 111-104 final score reflects how tight the game was, but the result was clear. Heat Streak Snapped in Philadelphia The loss ended Miami’s seven-game winning streak. Davion Mitchell tallied 20 points alongside 10 assists, whereas Bam Adebayo notched 17 points and 11 rebounds. The Heat now sit at 2-1 in NBA Cup play, just like the Sixers. sports.title: Raiders’ Jackson Powers-Johnson suffers potentially serious injury at practice
sports.description: An already-frustrating season for Raiders offensive lineman Jackson Powers-Johnson took an ominous turn Friday when he suffered a potentially serious injury during practice. Powers-Johnson was ruled out for Sunday’s game against the Browns and could be sidelined considerably longer. “He had an injury at practice today, and we’ll have more details for you tomorrow,” Raiders coach Klint Kubiak said Friday. Las Vegas Raiders quarterback Fernando Mendoza (15) celebrates a touchdown with Jackson Powers-Johnson (58) and Connor Heyward (34) in Las Vegas, Nov. 15, 2026. AP Photo/David Becker Asked if the injury was serious, Kubiak acknowledged the possibility. “Could be, yes,” Kubiak said. “We’ll go take a peek at him here after this and have more info for you.” It’s the latest setback for a player whose first three NFL seasons have fallen short of the lofty expectations that accompanied his arrival in Las Vegas. Jackson Powers-Johnson of the Las Vegas Raiders arrives at Allegiant Stadium in Las Vegas on Sunday, Nov. 15, 2026, for a game against the Seattle Seahawks. Getty Images The Raiders selected Powers-Johnson with the 44th overall pick in the second round of the 2024 NFL Draft out of Oregon, where he won the Rimington Trophy as college football’s best center. The expectation was that Powers-Johnson would become a foundational piece along the Raiders’ offensive line, either at center or guard. Instead, injuries and an inability to establish himself as a permanent starter have prevented that from materializing. Powers-Johnson started 14 games as a rookie, splitting time between left guard and center. His second season was cut short by an ankle injury. Las Vegas Raiders head coach Klint Kubiak speaks during a news conference after an NFL football game in Denver, Sunday, Nov. 22, 2026. AP Photo/David Zalubowski The offseason signing of Tyler Linderbaum effectively closed the door on Powers-Johnson becoming the Raiders’ long-term answer at center. And he has been unable to maintain a firm grip on the starting right guard job. Now, depending on the severity of Friday’s injury, Powers-Johnson could face yet another obstacle in his effort to establish himself as part of the Raiders’ future, with next season representing the final year of his rookie contract.

Venezia came into the game bottom of Serie A with six points from 12 games, after a 4-0 thrashing at Juventus on Sunday. Davide Nicola was without the injured Franjić, Šverko and Thierry Correia, but handed a start to Gianluca Busio in midfield. Bologna, ninth on 18 points, had drawn 1-1 with Udinese last week . Raffaele Palladino left Riccardo Orsolini and Artem Dovbyk on the bench, while Lorenzo De Silvestri, Emil Holm, Juan Miranda, Oussama El Azzouzi and Ukko Happonen were all injured. Venezia made the brighter start, and Skorupski had to dive low to his right to keep out John Yeboah’s effort after a defence-splitting pass from Akor Adams. The hosts thought they had taken the lead in the 14th minute. Halhal burst into the box to meet Antoine Hainaut’s whipped cross and finish into the bottom corner. However, the goal was ruled out for offside after a lengthy VAR check. Tempers flared in the aftermath, with Juan Jesus and Nadir Zortea both booked for dissent, and Martin Vitík and Hainaut soon joined them in the book. Skorupski was the busier goalkeeper in the first half. He produced a sharp save to deny Kike Pérez’s low volley on the half-hour, then thwarted Yeboah again from inside the box shortly before the break. At the other end, Jens Odgaard fired over from a good position and Arthur Theate headed straight at Stanković. Bologna improved after the restart, with Matteo Darmian on for Vitík. Stanković pulled off a superb reflex save to keep out Nicolò Casale’s header, and Federico Bernardeschi curled just wide from a set piece moments later. VENICE, ITALY – NOVEMBER 27: Riccardo Orsolini of Bologna FC during the Serie A match between Venezia FC and Bologna FC at Stadio Pier Luigi Penzo on November 27, 2026 in Venice, Italy. (Photo by Maurizio Lagana/Getty Images) Venezia 0-0 Bologna: Juan Jesus hits the post in dramatic second half Palladino turned to Orsolini and Nicolò Cambiaghi just before the hour, while Nicola sent on Thórir Jóhann Helgason for Busio. Helgason almost had an immediate impact. His set-piece delivery found Juan Jesus, whose header from the edge of the six-yard box came back off the post. Bologna brought on Roberto Piccoli for Odgaard, and he blazed over from Rahim Alhassane’s cross. Venezia refreshed their attack with Albion Rrahmani and Lion Lauberbach, and the latter forced a strong save from Skorupski at his near post. The chances kept coming in the closing stages. Stanković denied Lewis Ferguson’s header and then made his best save of the night to stop Tommaso Pobega from inside the six-yard box. technology.title: Smartphone shipments face another bleak year before modest 2028 comeback
technology.description: Global smartphone shipments are forecast to fall 14 percent this year and another 6 percent in 2027, with a recovery not expected until 2028. That's the outlook from Counterpoint Research's latest Smartphone Market Outlook Tracker , which points to rising memory costs and constrained supplies as continuing pressure on handset makers and buyers. The downturn was particularly sharp in the third quarter: IDC and Omdia estimated year-on-year shipment declines of 22 percent and 20 percent respectively, as rising prices and component shortages squeezed the market. Don't expect things to get better in the short term, as Counterpoint forecasts another 6 percent drop during 2027. But it believes that the market may see a 6 percent rebound in 2028, as memory supplies improve, pricing begins to stabilize, and pent-up demand for replacement phones returns. The 2026 outlook has been shaped by sharply rising component costs, particularly for DRAM and NAND flash. According to IDC , memory costs have risen approximately 350 percent since last year and are still climbing. As Reg readers will be well aware by now, this has been blamed on the memory manufacturers prioritizing output of high-margin chips to go into AI servers and GPU accelerators, creating a shortage of the mainstream components that are needed for devices like PCs and phones. Vendors have responded by raising prices, reducing memory configurations, and withdrawing lower-cost models. As The Register previously reported , memory costs accounted for almost 60 percent of the total bill of materials in sub-$400 smartphones during Q1 of 2026. For 2027, Counterpoint warns the outlook is for continued tight mobile DRAM supply, further price increases for low-power DDR (LPDDR) memory, and limited evidence to suggest short-term capacity increases. "The 2026 decline was initially expected to mark the low point of the cycle, but the memory situation has remained more restrictive than anticipated," said principal analyst Yang Wang. "Mobile memory allocation is still being displaced by AI and server demand, while higher costs are taking longer to move through handset portfolios and retail channels. The result is a much weaker 2027, particularly for lower priced devices and price sensitive markets." Global shipments are forecast to rebound by 6 percent in 2028, but that would bring shipments only roughly back to this year's already shrunken level, rather than hitting the peak of previous years. Counterpoint cautions that the scale of the rebound will depend on how quickly lower component costs translate into retail pricing. A speedy improvement in mobile memory allocation during the second half of 2027 could bring replacement demand forward and swell shipments, but continued competition from the AI market or another round of handset price increases would hinder recovery. technology.title: Bill for Birmingham's Oracle debacle reaches £128M
technology.description: Birmingham City Council faces a £128.1 million bill for its disastrous transition from SAP to Oracle – more than six times the original estimate for a project that contributed to its financial collapse. Papers presented to its Audit Committee this week put the combined cost of the original implementation, which went live in 2022, and this year's reimplementation at £128.1 million, against £19.96 million forecast in the 2019 business case [PDF]. The report , from program director Philip Macpherson, said the project's funding allocation had previously reached £157 million. The report said the new Oracle Fusion system went live in August without any priority-one or "showstopper" issues. "The program has now moved into the Post Go Live Support phase where [it] continues to provide extra support but slowly transitions towards 'Business As Usual' operating procedures," the report said. It is an understatement to say the same was not true of the first attempt to move the council's finance, HR, and payroll systems off its legacy R/3 SAP system to more modern software. The first project started in 2019 and was supposed to go live in April 2021, but was delayed by a year. After the council started to use the system in April 2022, it soon became beset by a series of serious problems. Although the council had planned to implement Oracle "out-of-the-box," it created several customizations, including a bank reconciliation system that failed to function properly. The council struggled to understand its cash position and was unable to produce auditable accounts . It has spent more than £5 million on manual workaround labor . The system move also contributed to it becoming effectively bankrupt , an event it failed to foresee due to the malfunctioning finance system. It later emerged that officials ignored a "red" warning prior to the go-live date. They were explicitly told the system could cause late payments, a failure to collect debt, and incorrect accounting if it went live. Officials gave the go-ahead regardless. The council decided to reimplement Oracle from scratch, while running the current system as best it could and implementing off-the-shelf software CivicaPay , now rebranded as Civica Income Management. Despite the apparently trouble-free relaunch, the true cost to the council is likely higher than the projected £128.1 million implementation bill. For a start, the original £19 million budget was supposed to support the software implementation for schools , but that was excluded from the reimplementation. Secondly, the council expected significant savings from moving to Oracle in 2022 through greater efficiency. The 2019 business case booked £27 million in savings from 2019 to 2031, for example. A 2024 analysis by Audit Reform Lab, based at the University of Sheffield, estimated that the disaster's direct and indirect financial impact, including lost savings and deteriorating tax collection, would reach £216.5 million by April 2026. technology.title: UK government rejects national consultation on AI datacenters
technology.description: The UK government has rejected calls for a UK-wide public consultation on the environmental impacts of AI datacenters, despite a petition attracting more than 39,000 signatures. Campaign group Protect the Wild launched the petition last month, calling for a national consultation that would consider whether further expansion should be restricted, paused, or halted until those impacts are properly understood and addressed. The nonprofit says the petition smashed the 10,000 signature threshold above which a government response is required in just three days, and the total stood at over 39,000 as this article was being prepared. In its response, published on November 23, the government ruled out the requested UK-wide environmental consultation, saying individual projects' impacts should be addressed through the planning process. It pointed instead to a separate consultation on its draft datacenter planning policy, open until January 8, 2027. "Datacenters are vital to the UK's digital economy. They underpin the digital services that people rely on every day, including public services, healthcare and the way people work. They also provide the infrastructure needed to develop and use AI," the Department for Business, Innovation, Science and Trade (BIST) says. "Building more capacity in the UK will support economic growth and innovation, while strengthening national resilience and ensuring the UK is well placed to realize the opportunities presented by AI." But it adds that the government recognizes the environmental impacts of bit barns are real and must be understood and mitigated, and this is one of the reasons why it established the Data Centre Covenant tests. This Covenant, published last month, sets out tests all compute sheds "are encouraged to meet," while "strategic datacenters" are required to meet them to qualify for additional government assistance. The government has yet to define which datacenters qualify as "strategic," saying it will publish further details and eligibility criteria in due course. Qualifying projects could receive help securing power and accelerating planning. Briefly, the Covenant tests are that operators cover any energy costs they create, so that communities do not have to pick up the bill; that they invest in local communities; adhere to the highest environmental standards; create jobs and drive reindustrialization; and provide secure and reliable access to their compute resources.
